text:
The nightly job failed because the disk ran out of space. The volume was at 98%, which didn't leave the job enough room to run.

Log rotation has been off since January, so logs have been piling up with nothing clearing them out. Last night they finally filled the disk.

I cleared about 40 GB and reran the job by hand. The rerun finished successfully at 02:40, so last night's output should be complete.

To keep this from happening again, I'd suggest:
- Turning log rotation back on so logs stop building up.
- Adding a disk usage alert, maybe at 85%, so we find out well before anything breaks.
- Finding out why rotation was turned off in January. It may have been intentional, and something could depend on it.

If nobody else has the rotation fix yet, I can do it. If you have questions or want to know exactly what I deleted, just ask.
